The Next Care Steps Checklist

What to gather, sort and ask before anything else gets decided about your husband's care.

Download PDF

The discharge is set, the rehab wants an answer, the pharmacy has questions, and the list keeps getting longer. Before anyone decides what comes first, make sure you have these in hand. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is simply something still to do this week.

Gather

Sort

Ask

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you gather, sort and ask. It doesn't put your husband's care decisions in order, and it doesn't say who should do what. Those rest on his whole situation and on the people who assess him, and they're what the next step below is for.

Ready for the next step?

You've pulled the list together, sorted it, and you know whom to ask. The care interview takes it from there: it walks you through your husband's situation area by area, so what comes first rests on the whole picture and not only on this week's list, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.
